title: Integration tests self-skip when data/kaggle is absent
evidence: integration_test.go:17-18 realStore() calls t.Skipf if os.Stat("data/kaggle") fails; data is present in this run so the three integration tests actually execute, but the guard would silently skip them in a bare checkout
suggestion: Keep the guard (it is a reasonable bare-checkout fallback) but surface skip status in CI so a missing dataset cannot masquerade as a green run

title: Ships query tools beyond the spec's checklist

title: Cross-file match de-duplication avoids double-counting overlapping seasons
